facts.fact: ANSSI, under the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy, held a workshop to validate the draft State Information Systems Security Policy (PSSIE), attended by public institution representatives, cybersecurity experts and digital-sector actors, who analysed, enriched and validated its components.
facts.system: Politique de Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (PSSIE)

note: One validation workshop with named outside participants; no published report of comments and no rule requiring it.
